title: k-Means++ Initialization
signature: def kmeans_pp_init(X: np.ndarray, k: int, u: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
hints: Keep a running array D2 of each point's squared distance to its nearest chosen center. After you add a center, update it with np.minimum.
Sample by inverse CDF: cum = np.cumsum(D2) and target = u[j] * cum[-1].
np.searchsorted(cum, target, side="right") returns the first index whose cumulative sum exceeds the target. With side="right", a point whose D2 is 0 can never be picked.
